page.layout: Page number top left "270". Running head "HORRENDA EXEMPLA" at top. Two verse columns at top (left column and right column, parallel). Below them, one full-width prose block of running text with a heading "DE S. MARTHA." and a date line, then prose continuing to the foot of the page with a partial heading "DE" at bottom right.

main_text.p: Deus, qui beatam Annam, matrem tuae genitricis fieri voluisti: praesta quaesumus, ut meritis utriusque, matris & filiae, regna coelestia consequamur.

Deus, qui beatam Annam dilectae genitricis tuae matre egregiam ad coelestis vitae gaudia sublevasti: fac nos, quaesumus, ejus meritis gloriosis ad aeternam pertingere beatitudinem, ex cujus puerperio, pro salute mundi humanam dignatus es assumere carnem.
main_text.head: DE S. MARTHA.
main_text.p: Omnipotens sempiterne Deus, cujus filius summa carne pro nobis, in aede beatae Marthae hospitari dignatus est, concede propitius, ut precibus & meritis illius, quae illum placide suscepit in terris, ab illo misericorditer suscipi mereamur in coelis.

page.notes: Verse columns are partly illegible in places; the page is damaged at the edges. Reading of some verse words is uncertain, e.g. "straviţ" and "Ægypto" may be slightly off. The bottom "DE" is the start of the next heading, cut off by the page edge.
